items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: All I remember was Edgar Hayes. He was the leader, he was the piano player...

ctx.x: So you were there for another couple of years, and then you were doing pretty much the same kinds of things. But do you remember the name of the gentleman who was broadcasting from the Victoria?
No, I don't remember who that was. All I remember was Edgar Hayes. He was the leader, he was the piano player...
